text:
All five Gate 2 revisions have been applied and validated across `header.json`, `units-001.json`, `units-002.json`, and `units-003.json`:

1. **`U17` (`useEntityFromUrl.ts`)**: Preserves `useRouteRefParams`, `useAsyncRetry` with `retry: refresh`, and the `errorApi` guard for `'No name provided!'`, performing the redirect lookup only after `getEntityByRef` misses, hiding `entity` only while a redirect is pending (keeping `entity` mounted when `refresh()` is triggered on a resolved entity), and listing every import used (`DEFAULT_NAMESPACE`, `parseEntityRef`, `stringifyEntityRef`, `alertApiRef`, `errorApiRef`, `useApi`, `useApiHolder`, `useRouteRef`, `useRouteRefParams`, `catalogApiRef`, `EntityLoadingStatus`, `entityRouteRef`, `useEffect`, `useLocation`, `useNavigate`, `useAsyncRetry`).
2. **`U07`, `U08`, and `U09` (`EntityRedirectRequest.filter` and `AuthorizedEntitiesCatalog`)**: `EntityRedirectRequest.filter` is typed as `FilterPredicate` (matching `EntitiesBatchRequest.filter`), `U08` applies it via `applyEntityFilterToQuery` as `entitiesBatch` does, and `U09` reads `(await this.permissionApi.authorizeConditional(...))[0]` and builds the filter with `this.permissionPredicate(authorizeDecision.conditions, request.filter)`.
3. **`U18` and `U29` (`useExternalRedirect.ts` and `useExternalRedirect.test.tsx`)**: Replaced `UNSAFE_LocationContext` with `useLocation()` from `react-router-dom` and mocked `useLocation` in `useExternalRedirect.test.tsx`.
4. **Changesets (`U35`–`U38`)**: Split into separate `minor` changesets for `@backstage/catalog-model` (`U35`), `@backstage/catalog-client` (`U36`), `@backstage/plugin-catalog-backend` (`U37`), and `@backstage/plugin-catalog` + `@backstage/plugin-techdocs` (`U38`), each with a package-appropriate public-API message.
5. **`U19` (API & SQL reports)**: Runs `yarn tsc:full`, then `yarn build:api-reports:only` across all five changed packages (`packages/catalog-model packages/catalog-client plugins/catalog-backend plugins/catalog plugins/techdocs`), and then verifies with `yarn build:api-reports:only --ci` across the same packages.
